{{Otheruses|Black Team}}
'''Black Team''' was a squad of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives operating in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]]. They were responsible for [[Mission to Lotide|infiltrating]] the [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] on [[Lotide]], [[Battle for Black Ice|capturing]] the [[Field Secured Container Vessel/Legends|Field Secured Container Vessel]] ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'', and destroying a [[Unidentified Torpedo Sphere (Fangol)|Unidentified Torpedo Sphere]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Fangol]].<ref name="Black Ice">''[[Black Ice (adventure)|Black Ice]]''</ref>
